description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different audio categories within a dataset, as indicated by the paper title. The chart contains five slices representing categories: Mix-Sound-Music-Speech (2.4%), Mix-Sound-Music (1.1%), Sound (16.5%), Music (20.6%), and Speech (29.4%). The slices are colored in shades of purple and gray. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. A legend is present, labeling each category with its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest proportion, Speech, positioned at the top and decreasing in size as they proceed around the circle.
